description: Search Fillo's curated example library (templates, implementations, and style recipes) for a use case before authoring a form from scratch. No credential needed. Returns full schema and code so you can adapt the closest match to the host app's routes, layout, and visual style rather than guessing. Always prefer adapting an example over inventing a schema. For prose documentation on a feature or the API (not a form to adapt), use fillo_docs instead.

capability.description: Restrict to a capability, e.g. 'uploads' or 'conditional'.

framework.description: Restrict to a framework, e.g. 'react' or 'dom'.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind of example.

q.description: What you need, e.g. 'contact form with file upload' or 'NPS survey'.

name: fillo_search_examples
title: Search Fillo form examples
